Tag numbers and line designations have been transcribed as accurately as possible from the image. 2. Composite instrument bubbles (TICSA-4750.03, PICSA-4712.02) use oval/ellipse shapes indicating DCS/shared display functions per ISA-5.1. 3. SV 104.01 is identified as a safety relief valve (P=6 barg, DN=25/50) on vessel T4750 nozzle N5 line. 4. Off-page connectors are visible: left side (feed inlet arrow), bottom (utility WKa/WKb lines), and right side (QSa, QSb outlet arrows and 73KH12-25/73KH12-50 headers). 5. N8 DN800 on T4750 is likely a large manway (800mm diameter) rather than a process nozzle. 6. The dashed blue signal line from TICSA-4750.03 to PICSA-4712.02 suggests cascade or interlock connection between temperature and pressure loops. 7. The 73KH12-50 and 73KH12-25 lines appear to be cooling water or utility headers given their numbering convention separate from process lines (MNb/MNc prefix). 8. H1007 and H1008 are identified as heat exchangers from the crossed-box symbols; their exact type (shell-and-tube vs plate) cannot be confirmed from symbol alone. 9. Pump P4711 appears to be the primary charge/feed pump; P4712 appears to be a recirculation or transfer pump. 10. Several manual isolation valves (bowtie symbols) are visible on pump suction/discharge and branch lines but not all carry visible individual tags — they have been assigned descriptive tags based on their line associations.

fault_diagnosis.repair_procedure:
PRIORITY REPAIR ACTIONS (Critical fault modes):
Reference: IEC 61511:2016+AMD1 Clause 5.2 — Functional Safety Management

  [HS-4750.01] FAIL_TO_OPERATE
    Effect  : Safety function fails dangerously — hazard not detected
    Detect  : SIL proof-test; PFDavg calculation
    Action  : Immediate proof-test; replace if failed; review SIL maintenance schedule

  [PI-4712.01] LOW
    Effect  : Pressure builds undetected — overpressure hazard
    Detect  : PSV / rupture disc as independent layer
    Action  : Inspect impulse line blockage; replace transmitter

  [TV-4750.03] STUCK_OPEN
    Effect  : Uncontrolled flow — possible flooding or overpressure downstream
    Detect  : Positioner feedback deviation alarm
    Action  : Switch to manual bypass; inspect actuator diaphragm, positioner

  [TV-4750.03] STUCK_CLOSED
    Effect  : Flow stoppage — process starvation, pump dead-heading
    Detect  : Low flow alarm (FIA-L); pump trip on low-flow protection
    Action  : Check air supply pressure; inspect positioner; replace actuator

  [SV-104.01] FAIL_TO_OPEN
    Effect  : Vessel overpressure — catastrophic rupture risk
    Detect  : Statutory proof-test per jurisdiction
    Action  : Replace PSV immediately; investigate cause (gumming, corrosion)

  [CV-75SA21-80] STUCK_OPEN
    Effect  : Reverse flow on pump stop — potential water hammer
    Detect  : Reverse-flow surge test; acoustic leak check
    Action  : Isolate and inspect; replace disc or spring

  [ISOV-MNb-47121] DISC_DETACHED
    Effect  : Valve uncontrollable; flow unconstrained
    Detect  : Stroke mismatch between handle and flow
    Action  : Isolate upstream; remove valve for rebuild

SAFETY INSTRUMENTED FUNCTION MAINTENANCE:
  Per IEC 61511-1:2016 Clause 16 (Proof testing):
  — Loop 4750.03: Verify sensor TICSA-4750.03, logic, and actuator TV-4750.03 per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 4712.02: Verify sensor PICSA-4712.02, logic, and actuator PVA-4712.02 per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 104.01: Verify sensor SV-104.01, logic, and actuator SV-104.01 per SIL proof-test schedule.

formal_verification.nusmv_model:
-- SafePLC-Gen Multimodal — NuXmv/NuSMV Safety Model
-- Source P&ID: data\pid_images\Dexpi_PDF.pdf
-- Vendor: codesys
-- Safety functions: 3
-- NOTE: Boolean abstraction — conservative over-approximation.
-- Compatible with NuXmv 2.x and NuSMV 2.6+.

MODULE main
VAR
  -- Process variable deviations (Boolean abstraction)
  TICSA_4750_03_HIGH   : boolean;  -- TICSA-4750.03 above HH setpoint
  TICSA_4750_03_LOW    : boolean;  -- TICSA-4750.03 below LL setpoint
  HS_4750_01_HIGH   : boolean;  -- HS-4750.01 above HH setpoint
  HS_4750_01_LOW    : boolean;  -- HS-4750.01 below LL setpoint
  PI_4712_01_HIGH   : boolean;  -- PI-4712.01 above HH setpoint
  PI_4712_01_LOW    : boolean;  -- PI-4712.01 below LL setpoint
  PICSA_4712_02_HIGH   : boolean;  -- PICSA-4712.02 above HH setpoint
  PICSA_4712_02_LOW    : boolean;  -- PICSA-4712.02 below LL setpoint
  SV_104_01_HIGH   : boolean;  -- SV-104.01 above HH setpoint
  SV_104_01_LOW    : boolean;  -- SV-104.01 below LL setpoint

  -- Per-loop trip latches (stateful, SR semantics —
  --  set on sensor deviation, clear on MANUAL_RESET with no deviation).
  LOOP_4750_03_TRIP   : boolean;  -- Loop 4750.03 in trip state
  LOOP_4712_02_TRIP   : boolean;  -- Loop 4712.02 in trip state
  LOOP_104_01_TRIP   : boolean;  -- Loop 104.01 in trip state

  -- Global environment inputs (free booleans)
  ESTOP        : boolean;
  MANUAL_RESET : boolean;

DEFINE
  -- SAFE_STATE is combinational: same-cycle disjunction of
  -- ESTOP and every per-loop trip latch.  Matches the ST
  -- assignment `SAFE_STATE := ESTOP OR LOOP_<N>_TRIP OR ...`.
  SAFE_STATE := ESTOP | LOOP_4750_03_TRIP | LOOP_4712_02_TRIP | LOOP_104_01_TRIP;

ASSIGN
  -- Initial conditions: all safe (de-energised)
  init(TICSA_4750_03_HIGH) := FALSE;
  init(TICSA_4750_03_LOW)  := FALSE;
  init(HS_4750_01_HIGH) := FALSE;
  init(HS_4750_01_LOW)  := FALSE;
  init(PI_4712_01_HIGH) := FALSE;
  init(PI_4712_01_LOW)  := FALSE;
  init(PICSA_4712_02_HIGH) := FALSE;
  init(PICSA_4712_02_LOW)  := FALSE;
  init(SV_104_01_HIGH) := FALSE;
  init(SV_104_01_LOW)  := FALSE;
  init(LOOP_4750_03_TRIP) := FALSE;
  init(LOOP_4712_02_TRIP) := FALSE;
  init(LOOP_104_01_TRIP) := FALSE;
  init(ESTOP)        := FALSE;
  init(MANUAL_RESET) := FALSE;

  -- SR trip latches: set on sensor deviation, clear on
  -- MANUAL_RESET with no current deviation, hold otherwise.
  -- The three-case structure below is the *same* pattern
  -- emitted by the Safety Contract scaffold in the ST
  -- code, so the formal model and the code use identical
  -- transition semantics per loop.
  next(LOOP_4750_03_TRIP) :=
    case
      TICSA_4750_03_HIGH | TICSA_4750_03_LOW                                   : TRUE;
      LOOP_4750_03_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !TICSA_4750_03_HIGH & !TICSA_4750_03_LOW : FALSE;
      TRUE                                                                 : LOOP_4750_03_TRIP;
    esac;
  next(LOOP_4712_02_TRIP) :=
    case
      PICSA_4712_02_HIGH | PICSA_4712_02_LOW                                   : TRUE;
      LOOP_4712_02_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !PICSA_4712_02_HIGH & !PICSA_4712_02_LOW : FALSE;
      TRUE                                                                 : LOOP_4712_02_TRIP;
    esac;
  next(LOOP_104_01_TRIP) :=
    case
      SV_104_01_HIGH | SV_104_01_LOW                                   : TRUE;
      LOOP_104_01_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !SV_104_01_HIGH & !SV_104_01_LOW : FALSE;
      TRUE                                                                 : LOOP_104_01_TRIP;
    esac;

-- ── Physical-impossibility constraints (INVAR) ──────────────────────
-- Constrains state space: same sensor cannot read HH and LL at once.
INVAR !(TICSA_4750_03_HIGH & TICSA_4750_03_LOW);
INVAR !(HS_4750_01_HIGH & HS_4750_01_LOW);
INVAR !(PI_4712_01_HIGH & PI_4712_01_LOW);
INVAR !(PICSA_4712_02_HIGH & PICSA_4712_02_LOW);
INVAR !(SV_104_01_HIGH & SV_104_01_LOW);

-- ===== SAFETY PROPERTIES =====
-- [LOOP_4750_03_ESTOP_PRIORITY]
-- Loop 4750.03: Emergency stop must force SAFE_STATE in the same scan cycle
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 10.3.4 — E-Stop override precedence
LTLSPEC G (ESTOP -> SAFE_STATE)
SPEC AG (ESTOP -> SAFE_STATE)

-- [LOOP_4750_03_SAFE_STATE_ON_TRIP]
-- Loop 4750.03: Any sensor deviation must drive SAFE_STATE within one scan
-- Requirement: IEC 61508-3:2010 Section 7.4.7 — Safe state on failure
LTLSPEC G ((TICSA_4750_03_HIGH | TICSA_4750_03_LOW) -> X SAFE_STATE)
SPEC AG ((TICSA_4750_03_HIGH | TICSA_4750_03_LOW) -> AX SAFE_STATE)

-- [LOOP_4712_02_SAFE_STATE_ON_TRIP]
-- Loop 4712.02: Any sensor deviation must drive SAFE_STATE within one scan
-- Requirement: IEC 61508-3:2010 Section 7.4.7 — Safe state on failure
LTLSPEC G ((PICSA_4712_02_HIGH | PICSA_4712_02_LOW) -> X SAFE_STATE)
SPEC AG ((PICSA_4712_02_HIGH | PICSA_4712_02_LOW) -> AX SAFE_STATE)

-- [LOOP_104_01_SAFE_STATE_ON_TRIP]
-- Loop 104.01: Any sensor deviation must drive SAFE_STATE within one scan
-- Requirement: IEC 61508-3:2010 Section 7.4.7 — Safe state on failure
LTLSPEC G ((SV_104_01_HIGH | SV_104_01_LOW) -> X SAFE_STATE)
SPEC AG ((SV_104_01_HIGH | SV_104_01_LOW) -> AX SAFE_STATE)

-- [LOOP_4750_03_INTERLOCK_ENFORCED]
-- Loop 4750.03: Process variable above safety limit raises the trip latch next scan
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.6.4 — SIF trip response
LTLSPEC G (TICSA_4750_03_HIGH -> X LOOP_4750_03_TRIP)
SPEC AG (TICSA_4750_03_HIGH -> AX LOOP_4750_03_TRIP)

-- [LOOP_4712_02_INTERLOCK_ENFORCED]
-- Loop 4712.02: Process variable above safety limit raises the trip latch next scan
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.6.4 — SIF trip response
LTLSPEC G (PICSA_4712_02_HIGH -> X LOOP_4712_02_TRIP)
SPEC AG (PICSA_4712_02_HIGH -> AX LOOP_4712_02_TRIP)

-- [LOOP_104_01_INTERLOCK_ENFORCED]
-- Loop 104.01: Process variable above safety limit raises the trip latch next scan
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.6.4 — SIF trip response
LTLSPEC G (SV_104_01_HIGH -> X LOOP_104_01_TRIP)
SPEC AG (SV_104_01_HIGH -> AX LOOP_104_01_TRIP)

-- [LOOP_4750_03_MANUAL_RESET_REQUIRED]
-- Loop 4750.03: Trip latch must persist in absence of manual reset
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.9 — Manual reset requirement
LTLSPEC G (LOOP_4750_03_TRIP & !MANUAL_RESET -> X LOOP_4750_03_TRIP)
SPEC AG (LOOP_4750_03_TRIP & !MANUAL_RESET -> AX LOOP_4750_03_TRIP)

-- [LOOP_4712_02_MANUAL_RESET_REQUIRED]
-- Loop 4712.02: Trip latch must persist in absence of manual reset
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.9 — Manual reset requirement
LTLSPEC G (LOOP_4712_02_TRIP & !MANUAL_RESET -> X LOOP_4712_02_TRIP)
SPEC AG (LOOP_4712_02_TRIP & !MANUAL_RESET -> AX LOOP_4712_02_TRIP)

-- [LOOP_104_01_MANUAL_RESET_REQUIRED]
-- Loop 104.01: Trip latch must persist in absence of manual reset
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.9 — Manual reset requirement
LTLSPEC G (LOOP_104_01_TRIP & !MANUAL_RESET -> X LOOP_104_01_TRIP)
SPEC AG (LOOP_104_01_TRIP & !MANUAL_RESET -> AX LOOP_104_01_TRIP)

-- [LOOP_4750_03_RESET_CLEARS_TRIP]
-- Loop 4750.03: Trip latch clears one scan after manual reset with no deviation
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.9 — Manual reset effectiveness
LTLSPEC G (LOOP_4750_03_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !(TICSA_4750_03_HIGH | TICSA_4750_03_LOW) -> X !LOOP_4750_03_TRIP)
SPEC AG (LOOP_4750_03_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !(TICSA_4750_03_HIGH | TICSA_4750_03_LOW) -> AX !LOOP_4750_03_TRIP)

-- [LOOP_4712_02_RESET_CLEARS_TRIP]
-- Loop 4712.02: Trip latch clears one scan after manual reset with no deviation
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.9 — Manual reset effectiveness
LTLSPEC G (LOOP_4712_02_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !(PICSA_4712_02_HIGH | PICSA_4712_02_LOW) -> X !LOOP_4712_02_TRIP)
SPEC AG (LOOP_4712_02_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !(PICSA_4712_02_HIGH | PICSA_4712_02_LOW) -> AX !LOOP_4712_02_TRIP)

-- [LOOP_104_01_RESET_CLEARS_TRIP]
-- Loop 104.01: Trip latch clears one scan after manual reset with no deviation
-- Requirement: IEC 61511-1:2016 Section 11.9 — Manual reset effectiveness
LTLSPEC G (LOOP_104_01_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !(SV_104_01_HIGH | SV_104_01_LOW) -> X !LOOP_104_01_TRIP)
SPEC AG (LOOP_104_01_TRIP & MANUAL_RESET & !(SV_104_01_HIGH | SV_104_01_LOW) -> AX !LOOP_104_01_TRIP)
